job.list.what: list the long operations in flight, with what each one is and how far it has got

params.name: all
params.what: include jobs that have already finished

job.list.answers: Each row carries the job's id, what it is, `done` against `total` in whatever the job counts in, whether it has finished or failed, and `cancellable`, which is whether `job.cancel` would be refused: a terrain download can be stopped and a link measurement cannot. Finished rows stay in the list, so a caller polling at the wrong moment still learns how what it was waiting for turned out. `running` counts only what is still in flight, whatever `all` said.

example.what: see what is running, and how the last things ended
